Before you start

Creating starts a truly empty draft — no products, no example content. Add your real product next, or open an existing project file. Opening keeps your current project unless the new file is valid.

Choose what to include

Tick only the products and logos the customer needs. Use Open setup to prepare a product.

Products

Set up product

Work directly on the product photo: draw the safe area, click to place anchors, then save once. The photo is only a reference — all positions are stored in millimetres.

Drag to rotate the model. For measured setup, attach a side photo with “Add or replace a side photo” below.

Add or replace a side photo

Attach a photo to the selected product and option above without recreating it. A new side starts unmeasured; replacing a side retires its photo mapping and visual drafts so the new photo is set up fresh. The model, other sides, logos and measurements are kept.

Add a product

One 3D model (.glb), one flat image (PNG, JPEG, WebP), or assigned side-view images (front/back/left/right) is enough. Each image stays on its named side.

Labels are optional and stay on their named side.

Advanced product setup

Prepared import (alternative path)

Import a prepared product definition

Import a prepared product definition JSON: explicit millimetre regions with measurement references. The file validates before anything changes; a failed import keeps the previous project. Imported products arrive with zero placements and provisional, pending-review measurement wording — never production-approved. An included bridge sidecar ships as reference evidence in the package, never as geometry. Product photos stay reference-only: no logo overlay on photos is calibrated by this import.

Drop your prepared product file here
or choose one from this device. Nothing is uploaded.
Map artwork photos (optional visual trial)

Provisional visual-trial mapping only: it aligns a side view photo with a measured region so the customer preview can show the artwork on the photo. It is never production geometry or calibration — the measured placement diagram stays authoritative. Photos without a saved mapping stay reference-only. Millimetre values are typed in by hand against the region frame shown below; nothing is measured from pixels.

Reference points (minimum 3; U/V normalized with V = 0 at top, X/Y in region millimetres)

Save a prepared master (advanced reuse)

Downloads the current source package byte-identical, for reuse as prepared input. Reopen it with “Open an existing project”. Anchors authored in Set up product and staged photo mappings travel with the master.

What changed

Prepare the operation sheet

Write the department's operational instructions and logo dimensions here. Customer notes below are read-only context: they never print on the sheet, only department text prints as operational instructions.

Technique settings (optional — only what you type is printed)

Logo dimensions

One or more measured dimensions per logo: pick the anchor, the artwork edge and the convention for each row. Horizontal (dx) needs a left/right edge, vertical (dy) a bottom/top edge — anything else is refused with the reason shown. Missing anchors stay unset with “setup needed”: the draft still saves, but the sheet prints a draft badge.

Anchor + safe-area setup (one-time product setup)

Click the product photo to create named anchors (inverse-mapped to region millimetres through the evaluated photo mapping — never guessed from photo bounds). Drag markers or use arrow keys (Shift for 10 mm steps) to move them; rename or remove them below. Safe-area corners stage a proposal only: the issued product is never changed here.

Review decision (optional office bookkeeping)

Record the office decision for this customer update. Approval needs the customer confirmation to match this exact update, and every logo to fit its allowed area. This is internal workflow bookkeeping, not a production release.

No return imported.

Revise proposal (optional — creates a new customer update)

Adjust a logo position, size or the project note when the return needs office corrections before production. Applying creates a new update: earlier confirmations and reviews stay in history, the customer must confirm the new update before approval, and sheet drafts for the earlier update are cleared.
